children: HAIN CELESTIAL GROUP INC reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $1.35B and a net loss of $304.9M, with diluted loss per share of $(3.36), reflecting a year-over-year revenue decline driven largely by divestitures and improved results from lower impairment charges versus the prior year.
Revenue was $1.353B for FY2026, compared with $1.560B for FY2025; change (13.2%).
Net income was a loss of $304.9M for FY2026, compared with a loss of $530.8M for FY2025; improvement of $225.9M YoY.
Diluted earnings per share was $(3.36) for FY2026, compared with $(5.89) for FY2025; improvement of $2.53 per share YoY.

Revenue decline was driven largely by divestitures and exited categories; reported revenue impact from divestitures/held-for-sale was roughly (12.6%), with foreign exchange contributing +1.9% and organic decline of (2.5%).
Completed sale of the North American Snacks business and initiated the sale of the International UK/EU business, reshaping the company’s portfolio and contributing to reported revenue reductions.
North America showed improved gross and EBITDA margins following the snacks divestiture; beverages and meal-prep categories grew while baby & kids softened, notably in U.K. baby purees.

Company continues a multi-year restructuring with expanded scope; productivity actions and pricing helped offset some cost inflation, while international operations faced cost inflation and volume softness.
